title: Lazur vs ChatGPT for Mac: which one fits your daily work in 2026
metaTitle: Lazur vs ChatGPT for Mac: Which App Fits Your Work (2026)
description: Lazur vs ChatGPT for Mac compared on price, screen help, voice, privacy and platforms. See where each app wins and which one to pick.
intro: Lazur and ChatGPT for Mac solve different problems. Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in the notch, sees your screen, points at things and answers out loud. ChatGPT for Mac is a chat app for writing, research and thinking, and it can look at a screenshot you attach. Pick the one that matches the problem you have this week.
tldr: Lazur sees your screen while you hold ⌥⌘, points at things and answers out loud.
ChatGPT for Mac is a chat window for drafts, research and long threads, with voice and screenshot input.
Lazur Pro is $18/month, or $15/month billed annually. ChatGPT's plan amounts were not on the pricing page I could read, so check their pricing page.
Lazur keeps audio and screenshots out of storage, according to its own policy. Check OpenAI's current privacy policy before you decide for ChatGPT.

blocks.text: Start with the problem you have this week. If you keep asking where a button is, or you want a voice that answers while you work, Lazur fits that job. If you want one place to draft, research and think through a plan, ChatGPT for Mac fits that job. Many people try both before they pick. The rest of this page shows where each app wins, so you can test the right one first.
What each app does on your Mac

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac. It lives in the notch. Hold ⌥⌘ (Option and Command) to ask about anything on screen, and Lazur answers out loud. It works in any app. It does not click buttons, edit files or operate other apps for you. It is not a plugin or add-in for any app.

ChatGPT for Mac is OpenAI's desktop app for chat. You can type, speak or add images. You can also send a screenshot, which needs screen recording permission. A floating launcher opens with Option + Space. Chat history syncs with the web version. Temporary Chats are not saved and do not use memory.

The app changed in 2026, so check which one you are looking at. According to Fello AI, OpenAI rebuilt the Mac app on July 9, 2026 and merged Chat, Work and Codex into one window. Fello AI also says the older app is now called ChatGPT Classic. Fello AI is a competitor, so treat that as a lead to check, not a settled fact.
Seeing your screen: pointing versus explaining

The biggest difference shows up when you ask, 'Where is it?' Lazur draws a circle and a label around the thing on your screen. Ask how to do something and Lazur guides you one click at a time. It waits for each click before it moves on. Your hands stay on the mouse, and you learn the app as you go.

ChatGPT answers in the chat window. You attach a screenshot, ask your question, and read the reply. The Mac Install Guide lists screenshots as a feature but does not describe any on-screen pointing. Check the current app before you count on it to mark a button for you.
A worked example: finding a control in an app you have never opened
Say you open a new app and need its export option. You have never seen its menus. Here is how each tool handles the same job.

items: Lazur, pointing: hold ⌥⌘, ask where export is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around the control.
Lazur, step by step: ask how to export the file. Lazur guides you one click at a time and waits for each click.
ChatGPT: press Option + Space, attach a screenshot of the window, and ask the same question. You get a written answer in the chat window.
Choose Lazur when the answer has to appear on the control itself. Choose ChatGPT when you want a longer explanation of the whole export process.

blocks.text: Voice: talking to Lazur and dictating with fn

Lazur has two voice jobs. Hold ⌥⌘ to talk to the assistant and hear the answer. Hold fn to dictate clean, formatted text at the cursor in any app. Snippets, a personal dictionary and clipboard slots sit alongside dictation. Dictation is unlimited on both Lazur plans. The AI actions are a separate limit.

ChatGPT's desktop app also takes voice input, according to the Mac Install Guide. That guide reports early trouble. Some users said the headphone icon did not always connect. It was a launch-era report, and the guide is sponsored by another app maker. Test the voice button yourself before you decide.

blocks.title: Test dictation first
blocks.text: Open Notes or Mail, hold fn, and speak one full sentence with a name and a question in it. Check the punctuation and the spelling of the name. A short test tells you more than any review.
Everyday tasks: timers, reminders and Calendar events

Lazur handles everyday actions by voice. You can set timers, add Apple Reminders, create Calendar events, write notes, control music and volume, open apps and links, run a web search and run Shortcuts. These small jobs add up across a workday, so they are worth testing early.

The sources I could read do not list system actions such as timers or Calendar events for ChatGPT for Mac. Its pricing page mentions scheduled tasks on Plus, which is a different job. Before you pay for a plan for voice tasks, check the current app and its help pages.
Research and long writing: where ChatGPT is stronger

If your day is mostly writing, reading and planning, ChatGPT suits you better. The Plus plan lists Projects, scheduled tasks and custom GPTs on its pricing page. Chat history syncs with the web version, so a thread started on your Mac can continue in a browser. Temporary Chats give you a clean slate when you need one.

Lazur research works differently. It runs in Lazur's own Chrome tabs through the Lazur for Chrome extension. It comes back with a summary and a report. That suits a job like checking several sites while you keep working. It runs in the background, so plan for the wait.
Who should pick Lazur

items: You often ask where a control or setting is, and you want the answer drawn on screen.
You dictate into many apps and want snippets, a personal dictionary and clipboard slots.
You want timers, Apple Reminders and Calendar events by voice.
You want research to run in Chrome tabs while you do other work.

blocks.text: Who should pick ChatGPT for Mac

items: You want long chats, drafts and research in a single thread.
You already use ChatGPT on the web and want your history to sync to your Mac.
You use Projects, custom GPTs or scheduled tasks, which the Plus plan lists.
You want Temporary Chats for work you do not want saved or remembered.

blocks.text: Price and trial: what each one costs

Lazur has a 3-day Pro trial with no credit card. The trial starts when you first open the app. After that, Pro is $18/month, or $15/month billed annually, and it includes 150 AI actions. Power is $120/month, or $96/month billed annually, with 1,000 AI actions. Dictation is unlimited on both plans.

ChatGPT's plans are Free, Go, Plus and Pro, each listed with a monthly billing period, according to chatgpt.com/pricing. The text I could read did not show the amounts, so this page does not quote them. Go is described as expanded access and may include ads. Open the pricing page and compare the plan that matches your use.

Compare on use, not on the headline price. Lazur counts AI actions, with 150 on Pro and 1,000 on Power. ChatGPT's tiers limit usage in their own way. Write down how many voice questions and chats you send on a normal day. Then check which plan covers that.
Privacy: what each app keeps and what it sends

Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so they can answer. They are not stored. Lazur says your content is never used to train AI models. Memory of what you asked and did is kept on your Mac.

ChatGPT's privacy history on the Mac is mixed. In July 2024, 9to5Mac reported that the macOS app stored conversations in plain text and did not use the standard macOS sandbox. The developer Pedro Vieito raised the issue first. 9to5Mac later updated its article to say OpenAI released an update that encrypts chats stored on the Mac. OpenAI's pages were not reachable when this page was checked, so read the current policy yourself.
Privacy checks before you install either app

items: Read Lazur's privacy statement. It listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut.
Open OpenAI's current privacy policy and the data controls in ChatGPT's settings.
Check the App Store privacy label for the iPhone app. It is not the Mac app, and Apple does not verify the label.
Keep client files, passwords and medical notes off the screen when you ask a question.

blocks.text: Platforms and Mac requirements
Lazur runs on macOS, on Apple silicon Macs and on Intel Macs. Windows is planned, not available. Check the [Lazur download page](/download) for the macOS version it needs before you install.

The sources disagree on ChatGPT's requirements. Fello AI says the desktop app needs macOS 14 or newer, on Apple silicon or Intel. The Mac Install Guide says Apple silicon only, but its content looks dated. Open chatgpt.com/download on the day you install, and check the requirement there.
Mistakes people make when they compare these two

items: Expecting Lazur to do the clicks. Lazur guides you one click at a time. It does not operate other apps for you.
Judging ChatGPT only on 2026 reviews. Many of the sharpest quotes come second-hand from a competitor's article. Use the app for a few days yourself.
Assuming Intel support is settled. The sources disagree, so check before you buy.
Forgetting when the Lazur trial starts. The 3-day Pro trial starts when you first open the app, not when you pay.
Thinking a screenshot stays on your Mac. Lazur sends the audio and screenshot to AI providers to answer. ChatGPT sends the screenshot you attach to OpenAI.

blocks.title: Read the reviews with care
blocks.text: Much of the 2026 criticism of ChatGPT for Mac comes from a competitor's article and from quotes it repeats. Treat those quotes as reports, not proof. Test the current app before you judge it.
Your first hour with each app

items: Install the app from the [Lazur download page](/download) or from chatgpt.com/download.
Grant screen access when asked. In System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording, turn on the app you use.
In Lazur, hold ⌥⌘ and ask where the search field in Finder is. Watch the circle and label.
In Lazur, hold fn in Notes and dictate one sentence. Check the punctuation.
In ChatGPT, press Option + Space, ask one question, then attach a screenshot and ask about it.
Compare the two answers, then decide which app fits the job you just tested.

blocks.text: Next steps

Pick the job you want help with this week, then test that job in both apps. If the job is on-screen help, start the Lazur trial. If the job is writing or research in one thread, start on ChatGPT's Free plan and see how far it gets you. For a deeper look at ChatGPT, read [ChatGPT on Mac vs Lazur](/apps/chatgpt).

faq.question: Is Lazur a plugin for ChatGPT?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac. It is not a plugin or add-in for any app, and it has no partnerships with any app maker. Lazur and ChatGPT for Mac are separate products.

faq.question: Can ChatGPT for Mac see my screen?
faq.answer: It can see a screenshot you attach. The Mac Install Guide says screenshots need screen recording permission. The sources I could read do not describe live on-screen pointing in ChatGPT, so check the current app before you rely on it.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur draws a circle and a label around what you ask about, or it guides you one click at a time and waits for each click. It does not click buttons, edit files or operate other apps for you.

faq.question: Which one is cheaper, Lazur or ChatGPT for Mac?
faq.answer: Lazur lists Pro at $18/month, or $15/month billed annually, with a 3-day trial. ChatGPT's plan amounts were not on the pricing page I could read. Open chatgpt.com/pricing and compare the plan that matches your use.

faq.question: Did the July 2026 rebuild change ChatGPT for Mac?
faq.answer: Fello AI reports that OpenAI rebuilt the Mac app on July 9, 2026, and merged Chat, Work and Codex into one window. Fello AI is a competitor, and reports on the rebuild were mixed. Test the app yourself before you decide.

faq.question: Is my data safe with each app?
faq.answer: Lazur says it listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut, that audio and screenshots are not stored, and that content is never used to train AI models. For ChatGPT, a 2024 report said Mac chats were stored in plain text, and a later update reportedly encrypts them. Read OpenAI's current privacy policy.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on an Intel Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur lists macOS on Apple silicon and Intel. ChatGPT sources disagree on Intel support, so check chatgpt.com/download before you install.

verdict: Pick Lazur if your problem is on the screen in front of you. It suits you when you need an answer that points at a control, a voice that talks back, or dictation at the cursor. Pick ChatGPT for Mac if your work is one long task, such as drafting, research or planning in a single thread. Start with the Lazur trial if you often ask where things are. Start with ChatGPT's Free plan if you mostly write and research.
